title: A list element is bounded by the running maximum
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a type, let $f : \alpha \to \mathbb{N}$, and let $L$ be a finite list of elements of $\alpha$. For any initial value $a \in \mathbb{N}$ and any $t \in L$, the value $f(t)$ is at most the result of folding $(u,b) \mapsto \max(u,f(b))$ over $L$, starting from $a$.
hypotheses_covered: The element $t$ belongs to the list $L$
